name: ESC-50: Environmental Sound Classification
description: A labeled collection of 2,000 five-second environmental audio recordings organized into 50 classes, designed for sound classification research.
citation: Piczak, K. J. (2015). ESC: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification. Proceedings of the 23rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia, 1015–1018. https://doi.org/10.1145/2733373.2806390
